scope: PR177-195 R6/R8 external product and independent validation inputs

claims.subject: R6 observation product support
claims.claim: Generic typed contracts bind supplied product, grid, timing, source, mask, and error identities; they do not establish the truth of product-specific decoding, calibration, QC, censoring, or covariance assumptions.
required_external_evidence: Selected product and decoder versions with immutable native scans and a trust-root record authorizing the signer for the stated site/product/use scope
Calibrated dBZ semantics and explicit echo, confirmed-clear, and below-detection states
Grid/time identity and source-specific QC, censoring, and assignment evidence

claims.subject: R8 independent physical validation
claims.claim: Same-operator synthetic derivative and learning checks do not establish independent physical forecast skill or finite-amplitude influence.
required_external_evidence: Future targets and native target-source closure independent of candidate tuning, with signer authorization checked against an independently managed trust registry
Independent physical-event cohorts with track provenance and preregistered, versioned weather/range classifications before per-regime sample-size preflight
Paired parent and candidate runs on identical inputs, masks, domain, and scoring
Preregistered finite-amplitude endpoints, metrics, and event-level data splits

limits: This records contract requirements, not obtained observations or physical-performance evidence.
